//: Re-run the generator when the farm adds, renames, splits or retires a pen. The farm data is the contract: a regex invented in code goes stale and starts accusing correct labels, which is exactly how the helper doc comment came to call Yashoda unpartitioned when it has ten pens.

labels is the UNION across both parks and across active AND retired partitions. Shed names repeat across Coimbatore and Channapatna with DIFFERENT label sets (Yashoda is 1-4 in one park and 1-10 in the other), and a retired pen still appears on historical screens -- so a label is judged valid if it is valid ANYWHERE. This check reports malformed labels, never unexpected-but-well-formed ones.

Every one of these display strings ALSO exists as a standalone shed row in locations (the legacy per-pen rows the partition catalogue superseded). That is why a bare shed name is only reported beside partitioned siblings.

source.environment: goatos-stg (the live farm data plane: api.goatos.mesha.sg and dashboard.mesha.sg both read it)
source.query: locations (location_type=shed) LEFT JOIN shed_partitions ON tenant_id, shed_id -- read-only, single SELECT in a READ ONLY transaction
source.crossCheckedAgainst: GET /feed-config/pens (117 active partitions, 74 distinct operational_location_display strings)
